{{Quote|I have a friend, a Wookiee medical officer named Syirlabradawk, who has been having problems with the N.S.H. for some time.|[[Trezya Nenei]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Investigation|Talus}}</ref>}}
'''Syirlabradawk''', nicknamed '''Syir''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They finally shut down his clinic and imprisoned him in their base. The Imperials will arrive within the week to transfer Syir to one of their more secure facilities to do who knows what.|Trezya Nenei, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
Syirlabradawk was a Wookiee medical officer and a member of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]],<ref name="SWG:MO" /> a pro-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] organization during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Wookiee was running an A.C.L.O. clinic.<ref name="SWG:MO" />

[[File:NSHBase.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[N.S.H. base]].]]
After the Battle of Yavin, the A.C.L.O. was in conflict with the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a Talusian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> N.S.H. troops shut down Syirlabradawk's clinic and imprisoned the Wookiee. Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium]] and A.C.L.O. representative [[Trezya Nenei]] then sent a spacer to the [[N.S.H. base]] in order to retrieve a confiscated medical shipment and rescue Syirlabradawk before his transfer to an Imperial prison.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> The spacer [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the N.S.H. mainframe in the base and managed to localize the Wookiee. The spacer then found a number of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] in [[Prison/Legends|holding cells]] within the underground bunker, including Syirlabradawk. However, the Wookiee refused to escape and abandon the other prisoners. The spacer thus accepted to help the Wookiee in retrieving his medical equipment in the base so he could treat the injured prisoners before leaving. Syirlabradawk eventually stabilized the prisoners and stayed with them until an A.C.L.O transport arrived to evacuate all of them.<ref name="SWG:MO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syirlabradawk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Syirlabradawk was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
